text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S conquered the Arima Kinen. 
However, believing this was only the 
beginning of her role as an "Ordeal," she 
kept moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fired up even more by her presence, Tap 
Dance City and Zenno Rob Roy embrace new 
goals to one day surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, amidst deafening cheers, 
Symboli Kris S makes a declaration. That 
she will continue to deliver "results" and 
aim for the top—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To do everything she can to serve as an 
"ordeal" for the Umamusume running today. 
All of it to bring about a "revolution" in 
the Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That powerful declaration sent ripples 
across all of Japan. And to fulfill her 
next "mission," she set off toward a 
brand-new start.
